name: Book of Skills: Volume I
description: A worn-leather bound book that introduces the basics of skill usage. Grants a small experience boost of 50 exp to any skill.

name: Book of Skills: Volume II
description: A curated manuscript of skill techniques. Grants a moderate experience boost of 250 exp to any skill.

name: Book of Skills: Volume III
description: A rare book detailing advanced descriptions of different paths to skill mastery. Grants a significant experience boost of 1000 exp to any skill.

name: Life Skill Stone
description: A radiant stone infused with vital energy. Grants the user a random Life-type skill.

name: Death Skill Stone
description: A smooth stone that absorbs the surrounding light and emits an unsettling coolness. Grants the user a random Death-type skill.

name: Null Skill Stone
description: A dull stone that defies classification. Grants the user a random Nothingness-type skill.

name: Health Rune I
description: A single-use run engraved on a token. Restores 20% of the user's health upon use.

name: Health Rune II
description: A single-use rune engraved on a token. Restores 50% of the user's health upon use.

name: Anomalous Essence
description: A concentrated mass of unstable energy extracted from an Anomalous Entity

name: Anomalous Shard
description: A fractured piece of crystallized energy source, when unobserved, the structure appears to shift.

name: Anomalous Crystal
description: A fully formed crystal of unknown anomalous energy, can be heard emitting a low-frequency sound wave in certain areas.
